title: Enzyme kinetics
caption: At low substrate concentration the rate rises almost in proportion. As the enzyme's active sites fill, the rate levels towards Vmax. The Michaelis constant Km is the concentration that gives half of Vmax.
alt: Rate against substrate concentration: rising steeply, then levelling towards Vmax = 10, with half Vmax reached at [S] = Km = 2.
description: At low [S]: rate roughly proportional to [S].
At high [S]: rate approaches Vmax, the enzyme saturated.

checks.name: at [S] = Km the rate is Vmax/2
